dmitri: quick follow-up on the kernel-flag playbook from the RFC — want to capture rollout steps for per-model enablement + fallback kernels

alice: +1. Can we standardize flag naming? e.g., `runtime.kernel.enable.<model_family>.<kernel_tag>`

carmen: prefer less granular: `runtime.kernel.enable.<model_family>` with a map of kernel priorities in config. fewer flags to manage.

ben: tradeoff: per-model flag gives faster rollback for noisy models. map needs UI support for per-model overrides.

dmitri: noted. my proposal: three-tier controls:
- global toggle (`runtime.kernel.switch`)
- family-level (`runtime.kernel.family.<family>`)
- model override (`runtime.kernel.model.<model_id>`)
Also a "fallback policy" flag: `runtime.kernel.fallback_policy` with values: `prefer-latency`, `prefer-cost`, `strict-same-arch`

alice: :thumbsup: How do we express fallback list? JSON blob in config service?

carmen: example config:
```json
{
  "preferred_kernels": ["opt-kv4", "opt-kv2"],
  "fallbacks": ["cpu-sparse", "quantized-16"],
  "grace_period": 30
}
```

ben: need `grace_period` explained: seconds to wait before allowing fallback when capacity constrained, or per-inflight-request?

dmitri: per-request TTL for fallback. default 30s. also we should record metrics: `kernel_select_reason`, `fallback_trigger`, `config_version`

runtime-bot: deployment queued: rollout kernel-flag v2 -> staging (dmitri) — 1 package affected

alice: for rollout strategy: canary on 1% of traffic -> observe latency regressions + output-diff on eval prompts -> ramp 10% -> 50% -> 100%

carmen: add automation: if delta latency > 5ms OR output-diff > 1% revert automatically.

ben: where do we store eval prompts? suggestion: `infra/evals/kernel-select/<model_family>.tar.gz` in object storage, tied to `config_version`.

dmitri: yes link them in config with `eval_set_uri`. Also add alerting to SLO: `kernel_select_errors`, `fallback_rate > 2%` alert.

alice: will create a short playbook doc in productops and a dashboard template. I'll drop a snippet for the feature flag UI after lunch.

ben: one last question: migrations for existing flags — we need a script to convert old `kernel_override` to new structured flags. I'll file a PR.

dmitri: great. I'll add this thread to the RFC follow-up checklist and ping legal for any compliance notes on per-customer overrides.

ops-bot: note: audit log will capture changes under `kernel_flag_updates` — retention 365d.

(ended)
